\section[(dialogue)]{Words from chapters 290-293 — a first pass}

\label{lesson:KA-R298-first-pass-words-from-chapters-290-293}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for a competition and a prize.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item half, whole, difficult, easy, important
  \item cool, warm, strange, wonderful, interesting
  \item deserted, crisp, tidy, messy, convenient
  \item mustard seeds, coriander, curry leaves, a tomato, a carrot
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
Half? (\textbf{\kn{ಅರ್ಧ}}, \emph{ardha}.) Whole? (\textbf{\kn{ಪೂರ್ತಿ}}, \emph{pūrti}.) Difficult? (\textbf{\kn{ಕಷ್ಟ}}, \emph{kaṣṭa}.) Easy? (\textbf{\kn{ಸುಲಭ}}, \emph{sulabha}.) Important? (\textbf{\kn{ಮುಖ್ಯ}}, \emph{mukhya}.) Cool? (\textbf{\kn{ತಣ್ಣಗೆ}}, \emph{taṇṇage}.) Warm? (\textbf{\kn{ಬೆಚ್ಚಗೆ}}, \emph{beccage}.) Strange? (\textbf{\kn{ವಿಚಿತ್ರ}}, \emph{vicitra}.) Wonderful? (\textbf{\kn{ಅದ್ಭುತ}}, \emph{adbhuta}.) Interesting? (\textbf{\kn{ಆಸಕ್ತಿಕರ}}, \emph{āsaktikara}.) Deserted? (\textbf{\kn{ನಿರ್ಜನ}}, \emph{nirjana}.) Crisp? (\textbf{\kn{ಗರಿಗರಿ}}, \emph{garigari}.) Tidy? (\textbf{\kn{ಅಚ್ಚುಕಟ್ಟಾದ}}, \emph{accukaṭṭāda}.) Messy? (\textbf{\kn{ಅಸ್ತವ್ಯಸ್ತ}}, \emph{astavyasta}.) Convenient? (\textbf{\kn{ಅನುಕೂಲ}}, \emph{anukūla}.) Mustard seeds? (\textbf{\kn{ಸಾಸಿವೆ}}, \emph{sāsive}.) Coriander? (\textbf{\kn{ಕೊತ್ತಂಬರಿ}}, \emph{kottambari}.) Curry leaves? (\textbf{\kn{ಕರಿಬೇವು}}, \emph{karibēvu}.) A tomato? (\textbf{\kn{ಟೊಮೇಟೊ}}, \emph{ṭomēṭo}.) A carrot? (\textbf{\kn{ಕ್ಯಾರೆಟ್}}, \emph{kyāreṭ}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[(dialogue)]{Words from chapters 294-298 — a second pass}

\label{lesson:KA-R298-second-pass-words-from-chapters-294-298}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for a peanut and spices.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item a peanut, spices, chutney, money, small change
  \item cotton, silk, an envelope, a postage stamp, a parcel
  \item a scooter, the metro, petrol, a helmet, a dictionary
  \item a bee, a sparrow, a crocodile, a leopard, a tail
  \item a game, a film, music, a competition, a prize
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
A peanut? (\textbf{\kn{ಕಡಲೆಕಾಯಿ}}, \emph{kaḍalekāyi}.) Spices? (\textbf{\kn{ಮಸಾಲೆ}}, \emph{masāle}.) Chutney? (\textbf{\kn{ಚಟ್ನಿ}}, \emph{caṭni}.) Money? (\textbf{\kn{ದುಡ್ಡು}}, \emph{duḍḍu}.) Small change? (\textbf{\kn{ಚಿಲ್ಲರೆ}}, \emph{cillare}.) Cotton? (\textbf{\kn{ಹತ್ತಿ}}, \emph{hatti}.) Silk? (\textbf{\kn{ರೇಷ್ಮೆ}}, \emph{rēṣme}.) An envelope? (\textbf{\kn{ಲಕೋಟೆ}}, \emph{lakōṭe}.) A postage stamp? (\textbf{\kn{ಅಂಚೆಚೀಟಿ}}, \emph{añcecīṭi}.) A parcel? (\textbf{\kn{ಪಾರ್ಸೆಲ್}}, \emph{pārsel}.) A scooter? (\textbf{\kn{ಸ್ಕೂಟರ್}}, \emph{skūṭar}.) The metro? (\textbf{\kn{ಮೆಟ್ರೋ}}, \emph{meṭrō}.) Petrol? (\textbf{\kn{ಪೆಟ್ರೋಲ್}}, \emph{peṭrōl}.) A helmet? (\textbf{\kn{ಹೆಲ್ಮೆಟ್}}, \emph{helmeṭ}.) A dictionary? (\textbf{\kn{ಶಬ್ದಕೋಶ}}, \emph{śabdakōśa}.) A bee? (\textbf{\kn{ಜೇನುನೊಣ}}, \emph{jēnunoṇa}.) A sparrow? (\textbf{\kn{ಗುಬ್ಬಚ್ಚಿ}}, \emph{gubbacci}.) A crocodile? (\textbf{\kn{ಮೊಸಳೆ}}, \emph{mosaḷe}.) A leopard? (\textbf{\kn{ಚಿರತೆ}}, \emph{cirate}.) A tail? (\textbf{\kn{ಬಾಲ}}, \emph{bāla}.) A game? (\textbf{\kn{ಆಟ}}, \emph{āṭa}.) A film? (\textbf{\kn{ಸಿನಿಮಾ}}, \emph{sinimā}.) Music? (\textbf{\kn{ಸಂಗೀತ}}, \emph{saṅgīta}.) A competition? (\textbf{\kn{ಸ್ಪರ್ಧೆ}}, \emph{spardhe}.) A prize? (\textbf{\kn{ಬಹುಮಾನ}}, \emph{bahumāna}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
